title: Video frame display
description: Reusable canvas display for PNG frame streams, including ultrasound previews and recorded replays.

source.build: No compilation; isolated web component JavaScript.

behavior: Receives PNG ArrayBuffers through a private MessagePort. Decodes one frame, draws it on canvas, releases the bitmap, then acknowledges its session and sequence. No network or device access. Shows replay/live provenance, dimensions and uncalibrated status. No distance or diagnostic interpretation.
